description: Classify the positive integers representable as (lcm(x,y)+lcm(y,z))/lcm(x,z).
guidelines: Three official partial-credit routes exist: 2-adic (or prime-adic) valuations, pairwise-gcd factoring, and the general prime-adic lcm-divisibility claim. A complete solution earns 7 regardless of route.
0 points for only stating that the answer is the even positive integers, without proof of either direction.
0 points for only stating WLOG gcd(x,y,z)=1 without further substantive progress.
The three partial routes are mutually exclusive; pick the regime whose proof technique best matches the paper. All partial routes cap at 2 points.

children.selection_signal: Paper gives a complete and correct proof of both directions: every even positive integer is attainable and no odd positive integer is attainable.
